score_definitions.inter_angle: mean_t angle(h_t^{l-1}, h_t^l); radians; null at layer 0
score_definitions.lens_entropy: mean_t entropy of softmax(W_U norm(h_t^l)); nats
score_definitions.attn_size: mean_t ||u_t||, u = attn update to the residual stream; null at layer 0
score_definitions.mlp_size: mean_t ||u_t||, u = mlp update to the residual stream; null at layer 0
score_definitions.attn_sideways: mean_t ||u_t - <u_t, h_hat_t> h_hat_t||, h_hat = h^{l-1} / ||h^{l-1}||, u = attn update
score_definitions.mlp_sideways: mean_t ||u_t - <u_t, h_hat_t> h_hat_t||, h_hat = h^{l-1} / ||h^{l-1}||, u = mlp update
score_definitions.attn_along_mu: mean_t <u_t, mu_hat>, mu_hat = unit centroid of h^{l-1}, u = attn update
score_definitions.mlp_along_mu: mean_t <u_t, mu_hat>, mu_hat = unit centroid of h^{l-1}, u = mlp update

text_score_definitions.settle_layer: mean_t first layer from which the logit-lens top guess equals the final prediction

layer_numbering: entry i is hidden_states[i]: 0 = embedding output; 1..L = transformer-layer outputs (L = after the final norm)
auroc_orientation: score as written, label 1 = machine; AUROC below 0.5 means the score is lower for machine text

skip10pct.definition: all but the first 10% of tokens

med5.definition: tokens with ||h_t|| > 5 * median_t ||h_t|| dropped (per text and layer)

med10.definition: tokens with ||h_t|| > 10 * median_t ||h_t|| dropped (per text and layer)
